answer: Like mycelium anchoring into basalt, our economy resists Sybil swarms through transitive trust staking. Validated peers harvest network nectar only when endorsed by mature nodes; any rogue identity rooted in the sable shadows must deposit non-linear collateral to attest for its replicas. Because trust verification scales with superlinear attacker cost, forging an army drains resources exponentially, starving synthetic impostors.
